comment: Example ComfyUI workflow using Workflow Logger node
description: This is a simplified example showing how to use the Workflow Logger node. Connect your actual workflow nodes to these inputs.

example_connections.video_input: Connect video loader node → filename output → id input
example_connections.prompt_input: Connect text node or prompt builder → prompt input

tips: Use the same csv_filename across multiple runs to build a dataset
The node will auto-create the CSV file on first run
Each workflow execution appends one row to the CSV
